about.text: Brisasoft is a software and AI company based in Vietnam, established in October 2024. We design and build AI-native products, digital solutions and software platforms. We are an early-stage, founder-led company.

vision.text: We believe the most useful AI products come from combining three things: strong software engineering, deep knowledge of a domain, and AI. Brisasoft builds products at that intersection.

about.title: About Brisasoft
about.text: Brisasoft is a software and AI company based in Vietnam. Our brand name is Brisa. We build AI-native products and software solutions, starting with our flagship product BIS.
about.companyText: Brisasoft is the company. BIS is a product owned and built by Brisasoft. We may build additional AI and software products in the future.

bispage.whatText: BIS (Biology Intellectual System) is an AI-native education product focused on Biology. It is built and owned by Brisasoft.
bispage.statusText: BIS is currently an experimental version.
bispage.ownerText: BIS is one of the products of Brisasoft, a software and AI company based in Vietnam.
bispage.ctaText: Get in touch and we will be happy to talk.
bispage.designText: BIS is designed to combine structured Biology knowledge, AI tutoring, exam analysis and personalized learning paths, to help students understand concepts, identify misconceptions and improve their learning outcomes.
bispage.focusText: We are initially focusing on advanced high-school Biology education and competition preparation.
